segments.title: Cold Open: Pepito Sign-On & Hype Train Derailment

segments.title: News Desk: Biden Withdrawal & Kamala Harris Consolidation
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple joins to cover Biden's exit, Pelosi endorsement of Harris, and extended review of Kamala 'unburdened' and coconut tree clips; Case coins 'Kamami' support term; Trump stand-up clip and Mountain Dew ally-flavor debate ensue.

segments.title: Jambalaya Debut: Who Is Burdened by What Has Been

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Cat Escapes, Florida Man, Paint Matching & Seagal
segments.notes: Viral video review: cat escaping cardboard tubes, Florida man street fighter, programmer matching paint by eye, Steven Seagal proposal joke, Superman/Endgame mashup, Seagal cop rampage clip.

segments.title: Town Hall: AI Biden Impression Takes Questions
segments.notes: Case deploys Pepito's ventriloquist Biden impression for live town hall; AI Biden fields chat questions on Kamala's feet, Jeremy Piven VP nomination, macron consumption, soup farms, and 2028 re-run pledge.

segments.title: Therapy: Sperm Counts, JD Vance & Beyblade Validation
segments.notes: Dr. Chath fields chat questions on Mountain Dew sperm effects, Fred Durst convention counter, coconut-pilled status, and Case's Beyblade validation craving; Kendall departs for mall mid-session.

segments.title: How To with Jeb: Face Dancing & Minion Lipstick Tutorial
segments.notes: Jeb and wood-trapped father watch smile-for-camera tutorial, Brian B. Cardi face-dance lesson, and minion lipstick face-paint tutorial; Jeb practices face dancing, father offers to be sold as lumber.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid to Ricky Peacock
segments.notes: Case thanks 20/21-month subscribers, announces 8pm call-in show on CASIM's channel, mentions upcoming apartment move for consistent schedule, executes Pepito raid to Ricky Peacock.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covers President Biden's withdrawal from the 2024 race and the immediate Kamala Harris consolidation, debuting the Jambalaya panel game and reviving the AI Biden town hall format. The broadcast cycles through viral video review, a therapy session invoking the pending Beyblade Tournament, and a How To with Jeb face-dancing tutorial before raiding Ricky Peacock.
